name: Basis
english_description: A small, historically significant 1993 English-language LPMud mudlib by John Garnett ("Truilkan", also the author of the already-onboarded tmi2/TMI-2, but this is an earlier, deliberately smaller project). A thin core-infrastructure sketch rather than a game: a two-room test area, a working registration/login flow, and a real bin/-command dispatch tree, but no quests, combat, or score command. Basis's std/ base classes, groups/access permission model, and bin command-dispatch system were later inherited by TMI-2 itself.
